character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
A full-body fantasy sci-fi explorer girl wearing elegant pangolin-inspired armor, illustrated in a highly detailed anime concept art style. Her helmet is modeled after a pangolin instead of a penguin, featuring layered overlapping scales that form a natural armored hood, with a realistic pangolin snout, subtle eyes, and bronze mechanical accents integrated into the design. The helmet has a large rounded glass visor that clearly shows her face.

She has medium-length messy black hair, large warm brown eyes, round brass goggles, and a friendly, confident smile.

Her armor combines steampunk engineering, light sci-fi technology, and medieval explorer gear. The shoulder pads, skirt, and leg armor are built from layered pangolin scales in dark charcoal, bronze, cream, and black. Numerous leather belts, straps, pouches, utility bags, buckles, tools, and a vintage pocket watch hang from her waist.

One arm is a polished silver mechanical prosthetic with intricate joints, pistons, and brass details, while the other arm wears matching armored sleeves.

Her outfit is practical for exploration rather than combat, with layered fabrics beneath the armor and heavy expedition boots.

The design should feel like a mix of:

Studio Ghibli character warmth
JRPG character design
high-end anime concept art
steampunk engineering
fantasy adventurer
subtle sci-fi technology
Color palette: matte black, dark charcoal, warm bronze, antique brass, ivory, cream, and silver metallic accents.

Rendering: highly polished anime illustration, crisp linework, painterly cel shading, intricate textures, cinematic lighting, premium concept art quality, centered full-body pose, symmetrical composition, clean silhouette, expressive eyes, whimsical yet believable engineering.

Background: transparent PNG (or plain white if transparency is unavailable).
